core_obligations: Reduce unique set disjointness to the lifted function using sensitive blocks and AND/OR submatrices.
Classify OR-free gadget matrices into disjoint all-one rectangles.
Build low-communication equality protocols in the nonlifting case and obtain the full randomized dichotomy.
difficulty_reason: The authors combine a sensitive-block reduction from unique set disjointness with a structural classification of forbidden-submatrix gadgets and equality fingerprinting to distinguish polynomial randomized lifting from logarithmic-cost nonlifting families.

dedup.scope: Actual complete journal DOI and CCC/ECCC identities absent in existing snapshots and root active-line checks. Independent randomized communication gadget classification. Distinct from deterministic communication, which has a different forbidden-gadget threshold and additional certificate argument. No support theorem counted separately.

compared.difference: Communication submatrix reductions and randomized equality versus affine parity-query gadget projections.
